fields.title: Design a Plan B
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each feature, name the Plan B and what to show the user.
fields.promptBlocks/1/text: Recommendation assistant 2. Automatic categorization of support tickets 3. Translation of product descriptions 4. Review moderation for profanity before publishing
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — offer to repeat the previous order, honest message. 2 — queue for later, internal processing, user does not see it. 3 — show original with language tag. 4 — critical: cannot publish without checking, so the review goes into a manual moderation queue, user sees "review under review". Rule of thumb: if an action is unsafe without AI, Plan B is not to skip, but to defer.
